children: RNS Number : 0958D  Samsung Electronics Co. Ld  13 November 2026
Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. (KS005930, KS005935, SMSN, SMSD, “SEC”) on November 13, 2026, announced that it will hold Samsung Electronics Investor Forum 2026 on November 18, 2026.
Communicate the Company's technological competitiveness and business strategy to investors, present our business vision, and strengthen investor trust.
Presentations on key topics of high interest to investors
- Corporate Overview: DS Division’s AI Direction
- Foundry Business: Powering the AI Era with Samsung Foundry
- Memory Business: Beyond the Compute: Memory & Storage as the Core Engine of the AI Scaling Law
- DX Division: Shaping the Future with AI
